description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of two models, Flan-T5-783M and an unnamed model, across six different tasks, with each task represented by a pair of bars on the horizontal axis, labeled as TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1). The vertical axis represents the performance metric, ranging from 25 to 85 in increments of 10, with no explicit label but implied to be a percentage or score. The bars for Flan-T5-783M are colored blue, while the bars for the other model are colored red. The chart shows that for TriviaQA (EM), both models score similarly, with Flan-T5-783M at 77.3 and the other model at 77.1, and for TriviaQA (F1), the scores are 82.8 and 83.8, respectively. In contrast, for HotPotQA (EM), the scores are 37.0 for Flan-T5-783M and 31.9 for the other model, and for HotPotQA (F1), the scores are 49.7 and 43.3, respectively. The 2Wiki (EM) task yields scores of 44.5 for Flan-T5-783M and 32.5 for the other model, while for 2Wiki (F1), the scores are 53.3 and 38.1, respectively. The bars are grouped by task, with no specific sorting order, and the chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar.
